question.text: Under SEBI Circular dated June 25, 2021, 'key management personnel' of an AIF Manager includes:

answer.text: Only the CEO and CFO, strictly two persons
All employees with more than 5 years of service
Only SEBI-registered investment advisers employed by the Manager
Members of the key investment team disclosed in PPM, employees involved in decision-making (MD, CEO, CIO, WTDs or equivalent), and any other person the AIF/Manager declares as KMP

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Ch 11.10 and SEBI Circular dated June 25, 2021, KMP includes: (a) members of the key investment team disclosed in the PPM, (b) employees involved in decision-making on behalf of the AIF including senior management at MD/CEO/CIO/WTD or equivalent levels, and (c) any other person declared as KMP by the AIF or Manager. **The Trap:** The CEO/CFO-only definition is too narrow. IA-registration and tenure-based definitions are invented. **Cross-Exam Context:** KMP definition tested in III-A (Compliance) and XIX-A; XIX-C tests the Manager's disclosure obligation when KMP definition expands. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** The 'any other person' clause allows the Manager to voluntarily designate key deal-team leads as KMP — this strengthens governance optics with LPs and reduces allegation risk if a mid-level leader influences an investment.
